meta.title: Antre: a home for your AI agent
meta.description: Antre is a self-hosted, persistent personal agent server in a single Rust binary. Your keys stay on your machine and every command runs in a sandbox.
hero.title: A home for your AI agent.
hero.lede: Antre is a persistent personal agent server in a single Rust binary. It runs on hardware you own, keeps your keys on your machine and runs every command in a sandbox.
hero.notice: Early fork: the first Antre release is not out yet. Until then, build from source or run the Nix flake.

demo.user: Pull last week's merged PRs and draft the changelog.
demo.agent: I fetched 14 merged pull requests and grouped them by area. The draft is ready for your review
pillars.title: Built to be trusted with your life
pillars.secure.title: Secure by design
pillars.secure.body: Your keys never leave your machine. Commands run in a container or an OS-level sandbox, never directly on your host.
pillars.hardware.title: Your hardware
pillars.hardware.body: A Mac mini, a Raspberry Pi or any server you own. One binary: no Node.js, no Python, no runtime to babysit.
pillars.complete.title: Batteries included
pillars.complete.body: Memory, voice, scheduling, channels, browser automation and MCP are built in. No plugin marketplace to be attacked through.
pillars.audit.title: Auditable
pillars.audit.body: The agent loop and model interface fit in about 7.5K lines. The workspace is split into modular crates you can read on their own.
features.title: Everything an agent needs to live with you
features.gateway.title: Any model
features.gateway.body: OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, local models and 40+ API providers, with streaming, sub-agents and parallel tool calls.
features.channels.title: Where you already talk
features.channels.body: Web UI, Telegram, Signal, Discord, Slack, Matrix, Teams, WhatsApp and Nostr, with a persisted outbox so replies are never lost.
features.memory.title: Memory and recall
features.memory.body: Per-agent memory with hybrid vector and full-text search, cross-session recall and automatic compaction.
features.sandbox.title: Sandboxed tools
features.sandbox.body: Docker, Podman, Apple Container or WASM, with Seatbelt and bubblewrap when no container runtime is installed.
features.canvas.title: Design canvas
features.canvas.body: Agent-built HTML designs in a live preview pane with versions, viewports and comment pins sent back to the agent.
features.extend.title: MCP, skills and mods
features.extend.body: MCP servers over stdio or HTTP, a skill system, lifecycle hooks and sandboxed WASM mods with capability manifests.
features.voice.title: Voice
features.voice.body: Eight speech-to-text and eight text-to-speech providers with fallback chains, including live transcription.
features.apps.title: Desktop and phone
features.apps.body: A native desktop client and an installable web app with push notifications, reaching your server over HTTPS or SSH.
features.learning.title: Learns, with your consent
features.learning.body: An opt-in review turns finished conversations into skill and memory patches you approve, with single-change rollback.
shots.title: A calm place to work with your agent
shots.chat: Chat with per-tool cards and inline diffs
shots.settings: Providers, channels and sandboxes in Settings
install.title: Up and running in a minute
install.lede: Antre runs on macOS and Linux. Open https://localhost:13131 after the first start and the setup assistant takes it from there.
install.script.note: Detects your platform and uses Homebrew, a package or the binary.
install.brew.note: macOS and Linux, from the antre-ai tap.
install.docker.note: Multi-arch image for amd64 and arm64. The Docker socket lets Antre sandbox commands.
install.nix.note: Runs the flake straight from the repository.
install.source.note: Needs a recent stable Rust toolchain.
lineage.title: The claw, the molt, the lair
lineage.body: Antre is a fork of Moltis by Fabien Penso, itself a Rust take on OpenClaw. An antre is a cave: a self-hosted home for your agent. Existing Moltis installs migrate on first start.
footer.tagline: A self-hosted home for your AI agent.
